messages:
maria: Morning — final run for tomorrow's announcement (09:00 PT). We need: final changelog link, docs PR link, a 2–3 bullet bench narrative for the blog, webinar slot confirmation, and who owns the inbound routing for the mailer? :rocket:
ken: We can hit that. Changelog draft is here: https://github.com/redwood-inference/changelog/pull/78 — waiting on tyler's review (one blocker).
jess: Docs PR live: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/432 — merged to staging; will push to main after canary completes.
sam: Canary scheduled for 09:30 PT, window 09:30–10:30 PT. Rollout plan: 10% -> 50% -> 100% unless errors > 1%, then we stop and roll back.
maria: Webinar slot — can we do 10:00 PT for a short 20m demo + 10m Q&A? Need speaker list.
ken: Speakers: ken (runtime), jess (docs), priya (bench). Priya's OOO but can pre-record a 5m bench segment.
maria: For the blog/announce perf bullets I want short clear claims we can prove:
- 2–3x latency reduction on long sequences
- ~27% cost reduction via batching + quantization
- p99 under 120ms on p4d in our bench
Need numbers + links to bench runs for copy. :eyes:
sam: Confirmed numbers from bench run #2026: https://bench.redwood/2026 — quick snippet: `p99=118ms, cost/token -27% vs baseline` (I'll attach CSV).
jess: Docs update: added streaming + function-call examples and a migration note. One TODO: short migration example for the KV cache change.
maria: Mailer draft is in Notion: https://notion.so/redwood/announce-mailer — who will actually trigger the send? Growth (tara) or eng? We need subject line options approved.
ken: Growth should send; I'll loop in tara now for send ops and final audience segments.
release-bot: Release candidate built: rc-20260321-43 (sha abc1234).
deploy-bot: Canary job queued — will start at 1748646600 (09:30 PT). Logs will stream to: https://deploy.redwood/canary/rc-20260321-43
maria: Any last-minute risk flags? Docs gaps? Legal review?
jess: I will add the KV cache migration snippet by 17:00 PT and ping legal if needed.
sam: If canary shows >1% errors or latency spike >2x baseline we auto-rollback to previous model variant; fallback routing enabled. I will monitor and post updates to this thread.
maria: Action items confirmed: ken — chase changelog review by EOD; jess — push migration snippet by 17:00 PT; sam — monitor canary and attach bench CSV; tara/growth — prep mailer send and subject lines; I'll finalize MKT copy once I have the bench link and changelog. :thumbsup:
ken: On it.
